title: Costume Enchant Stone
summary: Enchant Stones for costume equipment and the drop rates of the Enchant Stone boxes.

blocks.text: The Costume Enchant Stones you can get from the Costume Enchant Stone Box, with their rates.

blocks.title: Rates by Box
blocks.text: More Enchant Stone Boxes (boxes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and so on) will keep being added. Each box's contents and rates are on its own page.
Costume Enchant Stones are card options you can add to costume equipment.
Add an Enchant Stone to a costume in the enchant zone to apply its option.

blocks.title: Stones Become Bound
blocks.text: An Enchant Stone added in the enchant zone becomes bound to the costume you enchanted.
An Enchant Stone, once added, cannot be moved to another costume, so choose carefully.

blocks.title: Use the Wardrobe
blocks.text: If you want an Enchant Stone option on several costumes, we strongly recommend storing the Enchant Stone in the Wardrobe.
An Enchant Stone stored in the Wardrobe keeps its option while you switch between different costume appearances.
The box available now is the Costume Enchant Stone Box. Each new box will get its own rate page when it is added.
